points.name: health.oxygen.settings.monitor_register
points.interpretation: Registers callback 0x0c64d839 with filter 7 and user data 0.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_register
points.interpretation: Registers the same callback with filter 7 and user data 1.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.click_data
points.interpretation: The callback reads user data; 0 handles monitoring and 1 navigates to the threshold page.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_initial_hide
points.interpretation: The builder adds hidden flag 1 if monitoring is not enabled.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_initial_show
points.interpretation: The builder clears hidden flag 1 when monitoring is enabled.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_disable_hide
points.interpretation: The monitor callback hides the low-alert row when disabling monitoring.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_refresh_hide
points.interpretation: The settings listener hides the low-alert row if monitoring is not enabled.

points.name: health.oxygen.settings.low_refresh_show
points.interpretation: The settings listener shows the low-alert row if monitoring is enabled.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.hint
points.interpretation: The create and resume builders display low_waring1.oxygen.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.option_register_first
points.interpretation: The create and resume builders register the first option callback with filter 7 and user data 4.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.option_register_default
points.interpretation: The create and resume builders register option callbacks in the ordinary layout with filter 7 and user data 4.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.option_register_alt
points.interpretation: The create and resume builders register option callbacks in the alternate layout with filter 7 and user data 4.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.option_count
points.interpretation: The callback uses event user data as the scan bound while finding the current option object.

points.name: health.oxygen.threshold.option_target
points.interpretation: The callback matches the current event target against the option objects to select the persisted value.

evidence: The oxygen application manifest registers both page descriptors. The settings builder registers monitoring and low-alert controls using one callback with user data 0 and 1. The callback dispatches these cases. The threshold create and resume builders construct four options, each registered to one callback with user data 4. That callback scans option objects and writes the corresponding disabled, 90, 85 or 80 selection. Both pages clear their root slots on destroy.
scope: Only listed settings and threshold call sites while the respective page is active. Other ways to change monitoring, threshold persistence, measurement or alert delivery are not intercepted.
limitations: The option count controls an array scan; changing it or the target can cause invalid accesses. Mutating registrations and visibility can desynchronize UI and persisted health settings. Root slots are not thread barriers; shared-entry publication and rollback require system-wide quiescence. Device behavior remains unverified.
